title: Iodine as an efficient initiator for the transfer-hydrogenation from 1,4-cyclohexadiene to aryl-substituted alkenes and the deoxygenation of benzylic alcohols
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46838-46842
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07048A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sascha Kail, Gerhard Hilt
The transfer-hydrogenation from cyclohexadiene to aryl-substituted alkenes as well as the deoxygenation of benzylic alcohols in dichloromethane is realised with a catalytic amount of iodine at ambient temperatures.
